label: SAM3's documented I/O surface — STATIC REVIEW of the model card at the PINNED revision (fetched bounded, sha-pinned in ../fetches/); never a run

source.library: transformers (library_name) + the official sam3 repo (build_sam3_image_model / build_sam3_video_predictor)

cardAbstractVerbatim: SAM 3 is a unified foundation model for promptable segmentation in images and videos. It can detect, segment, and track objects using text or visual prompts such as points, boxes, and masks. Compared to its predecessor SAM 2, SAM 3 introduces the ability to exhaustively segment all instances of an open-vocabulary concept specified by a short text phrase or exemplars.

modes.inputs: images (PIL) + text prompt AND/OR visual prompts (input_boxes xyxy pixel + input_boxes_labels 1/0; image exemplars)
modes.outputs: post_process_instance_segmentation results: masks (binary, original size), boxes (xyxy absolute pixels), scores (confidence)

modes.inputs: video frames (pre-loaded or streaming) + add_text_prompt (text concept)
modes.outputs: per-frame: object_ids (the track ids), scores, boxes (XYXY absolute), masks (original resolution)
modes.streaming: supported (frames as they arrive) — the card WARNS: 'Streaming inference disables hotstart heuristics that remove unmatched and duplicate objects... may result in more false positive detections and duplicate object tracks'

modes.inputs: interactive visual prompts (input_points + input_labels; input_boxes) per object
modes.outputs: masks per prompted object (post_process_masks), ranked by quality score
modes.positioning: 'an updated version of SAM2 that maintains the same API while providing improved performance, making it a drop-in replacement for SAM2 workflows'

modes.inputs: video session + points/boxes prompts on a chosen frame with obj_ids
modes.outputs: per-frame per-object masks propagated through the video (propagate_in_video_iterator; multi-object supported)

identitySurface.videoObjectIds: per-frame outputs carry object_ids (ints) — the session-scoped track ids the identity-continuity metric consumes (the repo bridge: sam3-<id> -> EntityId)
identitySurface.zeroShotClaim: 'detect, segment, and track objects using text or visual prompts' — zero-shot on open-vocabulary concepts; NO class taxonomy, NO jersey numbers, NO GT-id correspondence

dtypeAndDevices: the video recipes in the card use torch.bfloat16 + Accelerator().device (GPU-first); the image recipe allows device='cpu'; this host has no GPU
saCoBenchmark: the card's eval benchmark: 'our new SA-CO benchmark which contains 270K unique concepts, over 50 times more than existing benchmarks' — the EVAL benchmark introduced with the model, not a training corpus; the card names NO training corpus
